requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size supporting >8K pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase consumables’ page yield, reduce frequency of replacements, and stay competitive in the CISS market segment.
requirements.Stakeholders: R&D, Product Management, Supply Chain, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with existing and new printer hardware; dependent on ink stability modeling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles are developed and validated to deliver at least 6,000 pages for Black and CMY, with CMY bottle physically sized for >8,000 pages, verified via print testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Design and implement a spill-free mechanism for the new ink bottles to minimize ink spillage during user handling and refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation is critical for customer satisfaction and reducing warranty/service claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on bottle and tank interface design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Spill-free performance is demonstrated in at least 99% of refilling operations during testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Introduce NOA-F (non-ozone air filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, while maintaining compatibility with existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances air management and supports reliability requirements for the new platform.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires redesign of NOA-F and alignment with current assembly processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F passes air management and reliability qualification tests; is compatible with push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse existing Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks, with no reformulation required.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D investment, speeds time to market, and leverages proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and tank design must be confirmed.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks function as expected in new system without reformulation.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Characterization Modeling
requirements.Description: Perform detailed reliability, WVTR (water vapor transmission rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (ink delivery system) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust performance and longevity under various operating conditions.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires test hardware and analytics support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive modeling reports delivered; system meets all reliability targets under defined conditions.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling for Tank Impact and Print Quality
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and its impact on print quality (PQ) across product lifetime.
requirements.Rationale: Critical to ensure consistent print quality and minimize maintenance issues.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires data from ink and tank interaction studies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability confirmed through simulation and empirical testing; print quality remains within spec for target page yield.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as serviceable parts for warranty support, enabling replacement during the warranty period.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires logistics planning for spare part distribution.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts are available as service spares and can be replaced in field within warranty period.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (likely a security or authentication feature) on the ink bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security and traceability of consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with lid manufacturing and supply chain systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All lids for the new bottles include Acumen 6; security features pass validation tests.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F production; add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5; ensure assembly of PHA, Dry FI, USG, and push-push in printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: Factory readiness is essential for launch and scale-up.
requirements.Dependencies: Capex approval and line reconfiguration scheduling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Production lines are modified and validated for new components prior to pilot build.

requirements.Title: New Keyed Caps for Bottles
requirements.Description: Develop molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps, supporting differentiation and error-proofing in ink bottle usage.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents cross-contamination and user error during refilling.
requirements.Dependencies: Capex for mold development, bottle design finalization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed caps are manufactured and validated for fit and function with corresponding bottles and tanks.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt LE/Marconi Hi Mech + CISS
requirements.Description: Utilize the Watt LE and Marconi Hi mechanical platforms, integrating with CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System).
requirements.Rationale: Accelerates development and leverages proven mechanical systems.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new ink delivery and tank systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mechanical integration validated and passes system-level tests.

requirements.Title: Print Speed Requirement: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer achieves a speed of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard, 20 ppm for color (PDL: 25/19ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets market and segment expectations for performance.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on hardware and firmware optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in standardized performance tests.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the system so that both PHA (printhead assembly) and NOA-F can be replaced by customers without service technician intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires user-friendly design and clear instructions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F with no tools and within 5 minutes, as validated in usability studies.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal: 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Set new warranty page life target at 80,000 pages for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with competitive benchmarks and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires robust design and component reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes accelerated life testing to 80,000 pages with no major failures.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Support a second SKU (Hi + Hi PDL) for Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) offering.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and supports recurring revenue models.
requirements.Dependencies: SKU definition and supply chain readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 is available for order and supported in all relevant systems.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID with an increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates higher ink capacity and supports increased page yield.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design and integration with printer chassis.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increase validated; no impact on ADF functionality.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product during shipping and meets regulatory/retailer requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Packaging design and material sourcing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS packaging passes drop and vibration tests per HP standards.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements (for PDL SKU).
requirements.Rationale: Required for market access and sustainability positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and documentation compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certifications obtained for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures smooth paper handling and compact form factor.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis design finalization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function reliably with new tank; pass all paper handling tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interface and usability.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Product Management, UI/UX Team
requirements.Dependencies: Display sourcing and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is functional and passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes, implement new tube routing and integration for ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Supports increased ink flow and reliability with new tank system.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design and integration with tank and printhead.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink flow is consistent and reliable in all print modes; passes stress testing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station, with spit platform changes due to new tank system.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces contamination and maintenance frequency.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and spit platform redesign.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels are within defined limits during operation; passes service interval targets.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable carriage motion and print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Final tube and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates reliably under all load conditions; passes print quality tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path to Support Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased warranty page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents wear and paper jams over extended use.
requirements.Dependencies: Component selection and durability testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components last at least 80,000 pages with no major failures.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended product life and reduces total cost for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance part design and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance part can be replaced at service centers; process validated in service trials.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, Keyed Bottles, Magi and Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Ensure all listed components are available as supplies for the new printer.
requirements.Rationale: Supports full ecosystem and consumables strategy.
requirements.Stakeholders: Supply Chain, Product Management, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All supplies are available at launch and compatible with new system.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce 140ml black bottles and new CMY bottle sizes (volume to be defined).
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with increased page yield and customer expectations for fewer refills.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design finalization and supply chain readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 140ml K and new CMY bottles are available and validated for use in the system.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Develop new make-break (connector) and FI (fluidic interface) connection for the ink delivery system (IDS).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable and user-friendly connection/disconnection of ink system components.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS redesign and component sourcing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Connections pass reliability and ease-of-use tests; no leaks or failures in 99% of uses.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Use LEBI ink-tank system with increased size, keying for error-proofing, and a single SHAID (security/authentication ID).
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher capacity, prevents user error, and secures consumables ecosystem.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and SHAID integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank passes capacity, keying, and authentication tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management system for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures rapid and reliable printer startup and minimizes air-related print defects.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS hardware and firmware development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup and air management processes validated in system tests; no startup failures in 99% of cases.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL for WS
requirements.Description: Leverage Marconi Hi PDL for the WS (likely workflow solution or wireless system).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development effort and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: WS functions as required with Marconi Hi PDL integration.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new algorithms for servicing and startup to align with new hardware and consumables.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures optimal operation and maintenance of the printer system.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware readiness and firmware development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithms validated in system integration and field tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Define new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion thresholds to align with increased page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output quality throughout consumable life.
requirements.Dependencies: Consumables and system integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion points validated in print testing across full consumable life.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for electronics subsystem.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces cost and leverages proven reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new platform and system requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Electronics subsystem passes all functional and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Enables modern wireless printing features expected by customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Wi-Fi module sourcing and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wireless printing and connectivity pass all functional and interoperability tests.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Utilize FW Dune as the firmware platform for the new printer.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP firmware strategy and streamlines development.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware compatibility with new hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer boots and operates with FW Dune; passes all functional tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security Hardware and Firmware
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx for security hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security to meet modern enterprise requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Security hardware integration and firmware readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass all validation and compliance tests.

requirements.Title: Business Model: Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise Segments
requirements.Description: Support business models for consumer, SMB, and enterprise segments, including PaaS and work-from-home/flexworker solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports varied customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: SKU definition, services integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Business models are supported in product launch and go-to-market plans.

requirements.Title: Solution and Services Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Meets enterprise and SMB requirements for manageability and workflow.
requirements.Stakeholders: Enterprise Customers, SMBs, IT, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Solution software and hardware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed solutions are available and functional at launch.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and ease of deployment in varied environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Driver and client software readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All drivers and clients are available and functional at launch.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years or 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Product must provide a warranty of 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with business priorities and customer expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Reliability and durability of components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are met in field and lab testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design and implement a serviceable maintenance box to support easy maintenance and reduce downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Improves service experience and reduces cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be serviced or replaced by end users or service technicians within 5 minutes.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Provide solution features specifically for SMBs, such as manageability and workflow tools.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses unique needs of SMB customers and increases market share.
requirements.Dependencies: Solution software development and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solution features are available and functional at launch.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Optionally support hosting 12,000-page CMYK bottles as a flexible feature.
requirements.Rationale: Provides future scalability and competitive differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank design readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 12K-CMYK hosting is validated and available as an option if required.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Optionally support trade page yield of 6,000 pages as a flexible feature.
requirements.Rationale: Allows for market-specific customization of consumable yields.
requirements.Dependencies: Consumables definition and regional requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 6K trade page support available for relevant SKUs if needed.
